fullBio: I am Ikhwan Ramadhan, a Computer Science graduate (B.S. in Informatics Engineering) from Universitas Putra Indonesia “YPTK” Padang. My primary discipline centers on software engineering and full-stack web architectures, complemented by academic specialization in data science, predictive modeling, and statistical analysis.

My engineering competencies have been developed through applied software projects and deliberate technical practice. Developing institutional platforms, transactional web systems, and dynamic user interfaces has afforded me hands-on experience in database schema design, input validation, authentication workflows, API integration, and production deployment.

For my undergraduate thesis, I conducted empirical research applying Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) recurrent networks to tropical cyclone trajectory forecasting. The project entailed rigorous hyperparameter tuning, validation across geospatial datasets, and packaging the trained computational model into an interactive client side web application.
I continuously cultivate foundational software engineering discipline, prioritizing code clarity, system reliability, and maintainable architecture as I contribute to professional engineering teams.
